claim_boundary: The successor is an internally complete all-degree theorem candidate over C relative to the named primitive-monodromy, finite-projective-subgroup, character-table, and composition-kernel results. The repaired Kummer v2 component withdraws the false uniform full-kernel claim and treats its exceptional even-exponent stratum by descent. Lean checks sixteen local arithmetic, spanning, scalar, and character consequences, and separate CAS implementations check the stated exact consequences. Laurent-series inversion, algebraic-function-field integrality, the direct Dickson field argument, monodromy, Ritt theory, imported classifications, novelty priority, external independent reproduction, peer review, and publication are not formally verified or claimed.
